items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And they liked the way I played and they brought me in because of that.

ctx.x: Working with the people? Talking about people, people interaction, rather than the music itself? The way people interact….

Well, they were all rich. And they were cool as hell. They were just cool. And they liked the way I played and they brought me in because of that. I think that, because of my work with Sting, they knew that I was not going to try to upstage the song. I was going to play what the song required. [And…] It was cool to hang out with them. [You know…] They told their stories about hearing Trane’s band. James Taylor…I just had a thing…. Like, his music, I love his music. And I know exactly what is required to make that…
You’re living in Carolina now. That’s where he…he always identified with Carolina.
